request.brief: Impeccable Read mode: authentic household photographs and precise Korean hierarchy. White/charcoal/cool gray, restrained blue footer; no ornamental lines, labels or repeated boxes. Keep the full frame of each real photograph with contain; all text sits in separate whitespace. Native1080x1920; safe area top210/bottom340; exact Korean copy and 24px separations. Each page conveys one practical suggestion.
